dataset_info.summary: Voice-assistant commands from Amazon's MASSIVE corpus, reused as sentences for a voice to read aloud across 52 languages. One row is one prompt, synthesised by every fighter so the clips can be paired in blind listening battles. Short commands are what a voice assistant says least — this set tests everyday phrasing, not long-form reading.
dataset_info.notes: MASSIVE voice-assistant utterances reused as a 52-language TTS read-aloud prompt set. TTS has no objective metric — fighters synthesise each prompt and the clips become blind A/B listening battles (human votes only). Cap with --max-samples for manageable battle pools.
